Frequently asked questions

How long does an engagement take?

A diagnostic takes 90 days; implementation engagements run six to twelve months.

How do you charge?

A fixed fee for the diagnostic, then a monthly retainer with a portion tied to the margin delivered.

Do you work outside the United States?

Yes, across the United States and Canada, on site every week.
